skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and structure of the state and legal system, including the functions and responsibilities of state institutions in Vietnam.
Grasp fundamental legal principles and the mechanisms for regulating social relationships through legal norms.
Recognize legal violations and the potential legal consequences for the perpetrators in various basic legal fields.
Apply knowledge to determine the authority of state institutions in legislative and enforcement activities.
Utilize skills to resolve simple legal issues in administrative, criminal, and civil areas.
Prepare and deliver presentations on legal topics, demonstrating understanding and engagement with the material.
Conduct research and analyze legal documents and regulations.
Participate in discussions and debates on legal topics, contributing to a deeper understanding of the subject matter.
Understand and adhere to rules, regulations, and legal responsibilities.
